decisions.reason: As a close-to-core shop extension, the net price display plugin can be supported with the firm's existing development and optimization knowledge, so it is likely to remain unless usage is clearly too low.
The ERP system interface plugin reinforces integration capabilities that are central to tailored multichannel commerce, making it the strongest strategic fit and least likely to be withdrawn.

This price comparison tracking plugin matches the firm's analytics and conversion-improvement know-how well, though some consolidation risk remains because similar tracking solutions are already in the portfolio.

The firm has the absorptive capacity to maintain and improve this tracking plugin, but among the remaining products it faces the highest withdrawal risk because overlapping price-comparison tools are the most plausible area for streamlining.
